name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; 5.9 GW winter margin
summary: No Electricity Margin Notice or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 22 Nov; NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW winter surplus
state: NESO's winter outlook says British electricity supplies are expected to remain secure this winter, forecasting a 5.9 GW surplus, about a 9.5% buffer over peak demand and within the reliability standard (NESO). The tightest days are most likely in mid to late January. Searches on 22 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Power cuts from supply shortages are not expected this winter. NESO publishes any margin notice on its website if conditions tighten.
rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas margin notice in force = Normal

sources.title: NESO — Britain's electricity supplies expected to remain secure this winter

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
